reason: Count is right (§3.6 line 94, §3.7(7) line 102, §6.1 line 206) but the remedy is the current state minus the guarantee text: §3.7(7) mirrors the FROZEN emitted guarantee string (certgate/report.py:144-153 'percentile cluster bootstraps -- asymptotic, with realized joint coverage at small cluster counts measurably below nominal'), pinned by tests/test_report.py and a CLAUDE.md invariant; §3.7 opens by saying the clauses ARE the deployed text, and a re-cast of §3.7 was explicitly declined 2026-08-11 (commit ad23e46). §3.6 carries the measured number (kept and to be labelled a design-time probe per PHASE1 P1-2), §6.1 is the Limitations mention the reviewer allows. title: SHAP equivalence stated in XAI-theory jargon
reason: The 'jargon' is the audit-mandated conditioning: S1-3 (closing R3-01, R1-18, R5-12, R4-15, R5-60 — five referees) required the value function to be NAMED because 'for a linear model these are exactly the SHAP values' is true only under the interventional / independent-baseline game or feature independence, and the generator induces ≈0.09 feature correlation (revision-plan.md:73-80; closure recorded 2026-08-10, revision-plan.md:27-30). The reviewer's proposed sentence re-opens exactly that overclaim. A plain gloss may be ADDED after the qualified sentence, and leading with the 'declined because feature A…' example is harmless, but the game name cannot be dropped.
